title: Dog Backpack
description: Give your tamed wolf items to carry in its mouth! Shift+right-click with an item to give it, shift+right-click with empty hand to make the dog drop it.
body:
![Dog Backpack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62debaa0ac706fc7f874fa682f2fad02e9f7ce1a.jpeg)
Dog Backpack is a simple and immersive Minecraft mod that lets your tamed wolves carry items in their mouth, just like foxes do!

## How It Works
- **Shift + Right-Click with an item in hand** - Your dog will take the item and carry it in its mouth visually.
- **Shift + Right-Click with an empty hand** - Your dog will drop the item it is carrying.

## Features
- Works only on **tamed wolves** that belong to you.
- Visual item rendering in the wolf's mouth (uses equipment slot).
- Colored chat messages to confirm actions:
  - Green: Dog is now carrying an item
  - Yellow: Dog dropped an item
  - Red: Dog already has something in its mouth
  - Gray: Dog is not carrying anything
- Lightweight and server-friendly.

## Requirements
- Minecraft **1.16.5**
- Minecraft Forge **36+**

## Installation
1. Download the latest release.
2. Place the `.jar` file in your `mods` folder.
3. Launch Minecraft with Forge 1.16.5.
4. Tame a wolf and start giving it items!
